description: Election Commission -  Declare that T. H. N. S. Ranasinghe  and  L. G. M. P.  Jayasekera as a members of the  the Karandeniya P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of members and the nomination of replacements by a recognized political party, which falls under election-related matters.
